question: Is the V1-scoped CoachingCore ready to freeze, from the reliability side?
verdictBasis: Two blocking findings, both with a small directed fix inside the one allowed cycle: QRE-V1FC-02 (the V1 'not 100%' screen accepts a missing or unknown condition and unrecognized sign keys, and asks 9 warning signs where 3b14804 asked the condition and, for an illness, 15) and QRE-V1FC-01 (an event date change keeps a marathon block for a race 9 days to 11 weeks after plan start, bypassing B1.6 and SSCTR B4; latent today because no V1X-MARATHON record exists, closable by keeping the marathon off). Everything else asked was verified by executed probes and holds.

findings.blockingScope: the marathon event (V1X-MARATHON). Latent in the candidate and in the worktree today: no V1X-MARATHON record exists, so a marathon is UNSUPPORTED at intake and every marathon program is UNSUPPORTED at review.
findings.title: An event date change keeps a marathon block for a race the intake would refuse as a block (B1.6, SSCTR B4)
findings.reproduction: p2b-mdate.mjs: development extension authority; marathon intake (16 weeks, race 2027-01-31) gives a MARATHON block; EVENT_DATE_CHANGE on week 0 with changes.eventDate = plan start + 9 days gives MODIFY REPLAN_FUTURE_PHASES with RACE in week 1 (completion race day); + 35 days gives a block with SPECIFIC in week 2, two TAPER weeks and RACE in week 5. generateProgram for the same dates gives the preparatory plan (unmet RACE_TOO_CLOSE). Same path through GOAL_CHANGE with the same kind. Cause: goalChange accepts sameKind for MARATHON and only checks the horizon and 7 days.
findings.smallestFix: In goalChange, a MARATHON event whose new date is less than raceWeeksAfterPlanStartMin (12) weeks after program.startDate asks for a new plan (missingInputs ['newProgramInput']), so B1 is read again at intake; or the narrower scope cut: a marathon date change always asks for a new plan (sameKind excludes MARATHON). Add a test. Closure by scope reduction instead: the freeze declares EVENT_EXTENSION MARATHON = OFF and any later V1X-MARATHON record is conditional on this fix.
findings.route: SSCTR for whether a date change inside the 12 weeks may ever keep a block and whether B1.8 applies to a moved date; the defect (a stated eligibility criterion bypassed) stands either way.

findings.title: The V1 'not 100%' screen accepts a missing or unknown condition and unrecognized sign keys, and then asks only the 9 generic warning signs
findings.reproduction: p1c-condition.mjs: NOT_FEELING_100 with wellbeing {warningSigns: the 9 generic signs answered no} and no condition gives KEEP with the unavailability; condition 'FLU' or 7 gives KEEP; an extra unknown sign key set true gives KEEP. The same inputs at 3b14804 (and in the research engine) are ASK wellbeing.condition, ASK the 6 systemic signs, ASK wellbeing.warningSigns.unrecognized. For MILD_ILLNESS stated, V1 asks all 15 signs; omitting the condition skips 6 of them (body-wide aches, exhaustion at rest, vomiting/diarrhoea/nausea/abdominal pain, cough, severe headache, severe nose or throat). Reachable through custody: the wellbeing field is forwarded unvalidated.
findings.smallestFix: In temporaryReductionOutsideV1, validate as readWellbeing does before the KEEP: a condition outside the condition vocabulary asks wellbeing.condition; unrecognized or non-boolean sign keys ask (as at 3b14804); then the signs of that condition. Add a test with no condition, an unknown condition and an unknown key.
findings.route: SSCTR for the instrument (which signs a V1 report must answer); the input-validation regression against 3b14804 is a reliability defect regardless.

findings.title: A second report of a session already on record, sent without correctionOf, fails ENGINE_CONTRACT_VIOLATION instead of a typed answer
findings.reproduction: p4c-dupmiss.mjs / p4d-dupdone.mjs: logRun of a missed or an executed session, then the same report under a new clientRequestId: ok:false ENGINE_CONTRACT_VIOLATION ('a stored row is missing' / 'a stored row changed'); nothing kept; a later check-in works. A correction with correctionOf works.
findings.smallestFix: Custody (or the engine) answers a typed status for a repeated report (ASK observations.correction, or KEEP as already recorded) instead of the contract-violation error; or the API dedupes by session before submitting. Condition for INTEGRATION_READY, not for the engine freeze.

findings.title: A V1 restart over a record that holds a temporary-reduction report makes a plan that every later V1 review holds
findings.reproduction: p1b-restart.mjs: research engine opens a window; V1 restartProgram with that record gives PROPOSED; the first weekly review and a readiness declaration on the new plan are HOLD record.outsideV1Scope. Only reachable with a record not kept by V1.
findings.smallestFix: Under V1 scope, restartProgram returns HOLD record.outsideV1Scope for such a record (as evaluate does), so no unreviewable plan is stored.

findings.title: The V1 entry point forwards caller options that enable 5K/marathon without an SSCTR record
findings.reproduction: p2-events.mjs: V1.generateProgram(marathonIntake, {eventExtension: <any object with approved V1X-MARATHON and the values>}) or {eventRecords: <self-written record>} gives a MARATHON block. Custody passes no options, so the app cannot reach it; an in-process caller can. The v1-index comment says caller values for its option keys are overwritten; only scope is.
findings.smallestFix: Integration condition: the product calls the engine only through custody's default engine with no options; or v1-index drops eventExtension/eventRecords unless a development flag is set, and the comment is corrected.

findings.title: The event state depends on a records file outside the candidate bytes, read once at module load and not pinned
findings.reproduction: p6-extfiles.mjs: with a records file at the default path the 5K is planned as an event; with none it falls back; neither changes any program hash or the engine bytes. The worktree holds such a file now, untracked (sha256 b2bcc23a...).
findings.smallestFix: The freeze record names the records file and its sha256 (or its absence) next to 2d089c0 and the extension pin, and reports EVENT_EXTENSION per that file; a process restart is needed after it changes.

findings.reproduction: p5-mutate.mjs: M04, M09, M15, M26, M30, M35 survive the full suite (M13, M14 are equivalent under current paths).
